relationship_to_r20: independent challenger; never replaces or feeds R20 without explicit promotion
primary_objective: select a small daily stock set with the highest reliable upside-target confidence
primary_index: 100 * calibrated P(hit +25% before hit -15% by session 20)

baseline_history.name: B0-window-extrema-probability
baseline_history.limitation: uses window extrema and does not identify barrier order

candidate_ladder: B4 TRA regime-routed mixture of experts
B6 MASTER market and cross-sectional context
B7 TACTiS or diffusion joint-path distribution only if simpler models justify it
calibration: rolling adaptive conformal or Conformal PID after raw probability calibration

validation.method: purged chronological walk-forward with fit, tune, calibration and test windows
